requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to start the watchdog, the IWDG LL driver shall write 0x0000CCCC to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U].KEY equals 0x0000CCCC after the call to the start function.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to refresh the watchdog counter, the IWDG LL driver shall write 0x0000AAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U].KEY equals 0x0000AAAA after the call to the refresh function.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to enable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U].KEY equals 0x00005555 after the call to the enable write access function.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to disable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write any value except 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U].KEY is not equal to 0x00005555 after the call to the disable write access function.
